item.title: Trump says AI risks can be managed, signals openness to guardrails
item.description:
Nov 8 (Reuters) - US President Donald Trump said the ​risks posed by artificial intelligence ‌can be managed but signaled an openness to safeguards, telling CBS's "60 Minutes" ​that he "doesn't mind guardrails."
Asked ​whether the United States should accept ⁠the risks of artificial ​intelligence in order to stay ahead ​of China, Trump said the dangers were manageable and expressed openness to working ​with Democrats on safeguards.

item.title: The American Pakistan Foundation (APF) Announces 2026 Rising Stars in Artificial Intelligence
item.description:
### most recent stories _APF Rising Stars in Artificial Intelligence 2026 celebrates the achievements of Pakistani-American women driving innovation and advancing responsible AI._
NJ, UNITED STATES, November 8, 2026 / [EINPresswire.com](https://www.einpresswire.com/)/ — The American Pakistan Foundation (APF) proudly announces its Rising Stars in Artificial Intelligence 2026 List, recognizing outstanding Pakistani-American women who are making significant contributions to one of the world’s most rapidly evolving fields.
This year’s theme, “Rising Stars in Artificial Intelligence,” celebrates women at the forefront of technological innovation, research, entrepreneurship, and AI policy. From developing groundbreaking applications to advancing ethical AI and expanding access to emerging technologies, these leaders are helping shape how artificial intelligence transforms industries, communities, and everyday life.
As artificial intelligence continues to reshape economies, industries, and societies, ensuring that women have a meaningful role in developing and governing these technologies has never been more important.
By sharing their stories and connecting them with APF’s broader network of professionals, mentors, and community leaders, the initiative aims to inspire more young women to pursue careers in artificial intelligence and emerging technologies.
